t2.title: Books in the digital age
t2.prompt:
You are participating in an online discussion for students and readers.

The question is:

"Are books still important in the digital age?"
t2.sample: In today's digital age, some people argue that printed books have become unnecessary. However, I firmly believe that books remain as important as ever. Firstly, reading a physical book offers a level of focus that screens rarely provide. Without notifications and endless links, readers can concentrate deeply and absorb information more effectively. Secondly, books are reliable. They do not depend on batteries, internet access or a particular device, which means knowledge stored in print can be preserved for generations. That said, I acknowledge that digital formats have clear advantages: they are portable, searchable and often cheaper. For students and travellers, an e-reader can hold an entire library. Nevertheless, digital tools should complement books rather than replace them. In conclusion, although technology has transformed how we read, books continue to play a vital role in education and culture. Rather than choosing one over the other, we should value both for what they uniquely offer.
t2.sampleA1: Many people read on phones now. But I think books are important. I like real books. I can read them everywhere. Books do not need batteries. Digital books are also good. They are light. I think both are good. Books are important for me.
t2.sampleA2: Today many people read on phones and computers. Some people think books are not important now. But I think books are still important. When I read a book, I can concentrate well. Books do not need internet or batteries. Digital books are also good because they are light and cheap. I think we can use both. In conclusion, books are still important for me and for students, so we should keep them.
t2.sampleB1: These days many people read on screens, and some think books are not important. But I think books are still important. First, when I read a real book, I can concentrate better because my phone does not interrupt me. Second, books do not need electricity or the internet, so they always work. Of course, digital books also have good points. They are light and you can carry many on one device. In my opinion, we should use both. In conclusion, technology is useful, but books are still important for reading and learning, so we should not forget them.
t2.sampleB2: Hey everyone, great topic — I've been mulling this over for a while, so I'll jump straight in. In my view, books are absolutely still important, even though we're surrounded by screens. For one thing, when I sit down with a printed book, I can actually switch off from all the notifications and get lost in the story. That kind of deep focus is really hard to come by online. On top of that, books don't rely on a battery or a Wi-Fi signal, so they're reliable and can be passed down for generations. That said, I won't pretend digital reading has no perks. E-readers are light, easy to search, and you can carry a whole library in your pocket — a lifesaver when you're travelling. To my mind, though, the two should go hand in hand rather than compete. So no, I don't think books are on their way out. If anything, they still have a big part to play in how we learn and unwind. What do you all reckon? Do you prefer paper or screens? Would love to hear your thoughts! Dilshod Rakhimov
t2.uzSample: Bugungi raqamli davrda ba'zilar bosma kitoblar keraksiz bo'lib qoldi deb hisoblaydi. Biroq, men kitoblar hamon muhim ekaniga qat'iy ishonaman. Birinchidan, qog'oz kitob o'qish ekranlar kamdan-kam beradigan diqqat darajasini beradi. Bildirishnomalar va cheksiz havolalarsiz o'quvchi chuqur diqqatini jamlab, ma'lumotni yaxshiroq o'zlashtiradi. Ikkinchidan, kitoblar ishonchli. Ular batareya, internet yoki muayyan qurilmaga bog'liq emas, shuning uchun bosma bilimlar avlodlarga saqlanadi. Shu bilan birga, raqamli formatlarning afzalliklari borligini tan olaman: ular yengil, qidirish oson va ko'pincha arzon. Talabalar va sayohatchilar uchun elektron o'qigich butun kutubxonani saqlaydi. Shunga qaramay, raqamli vositalar kitoblarni almashtirmasdan, to'ldirishi kerak. Xulosa qilib aytganda, texnologiya o'qishni o'zgartirgan bo'lsa-da, kitoblar ta'lim va madaniyatda muhim rol o'ynashda davom etadi. Bittasini tanlash o'rniga, ikkalasini ham qadrlashimiz kerak.
t2.uzSampleA1: Ko'p odam telefonda o'qiydi. Lekin menimcha kitoblar muhim. Men haqiqiy kitoblarni yaxshi ko'raman. Ularni hamma joyda o'qiyman. Kitoblarga batareya kerak emas. Raqamli kitoblar ham yaxshi. Ular yengil. Menimcha ikkalasi ham yaxshi. Kitoblar men uchun muhim.
t2.uzSampleA2: Bugun ko'p odam telefon va kompyuterda o'qiydi. Ba'zilar kitoblar hozir muhim emas deydi. Lekin men kitoblar hamon muhim deb o'ylayman. Kitob o'qiganimda yaxshi diqqat qilaman. Kitoblarga internet yoki batareya kerak emas. Raqamli kitoblar ham yaxshi, chunki yengil va arzon. Menimcha, ikkalasini ishlatsa bo'ladi. Xulosa, kitoblar men uchun va talabalar uchun muhim.
t2.uzSampleB1: Hozir ko'p odam ekranda o'qiydi, va ba'zilar kitoblar muhim emas deb o'ylaydi. Lekin men kitoblar hamon muhim deb o'ylayman. Birinchidan, haqiqiy kitob o'qiganimda yaxshiroq diqqat qilaman, chunki telefonim xalaqit bermaydi. Ikkinchidan, kitoblarga elektr yoki internet kerak emas, shuning uchun ular doim ishlaydi. Albatta, raqamli kitoblarning ham yaxshi tomonlari bor. Ular yengil va bitta qurilmada ko'pini olib yurish mumkin. Menimcha, ikkalasini ham ishlatishimiz kerak. Xulosa, texnologiya foydali, lekin kitoblar hamon muhim.
t2.uzSampleB2: Raqamli davrda ba'zilar bosma kitoblar endi kerak emas deb o'ylaydi. Biroq, men kitoblar hamon juda muhim deb hisoblayman. Birinchidan, qog'oz kitob o'qish diqqatni jamlashga yordam beradi, chunki bizni chalg'itadigan bildirishnomalar yo'q. Ikkinchidan, kitoblarga batareya yoki internet kerak emas, shuning uchun ular ishonchli va uzoq xizmat qiladi. Albatta, raqamli formatlarning ham afzalliklari bor: ular yengil, qidirish oson va ko'pincha arzon. Bitta qurilma yuzlab kitobni saqlaydi. Shunga qaramay, menimcha, texnologiya kitoblarni almashtirmasligi, qo'llab-quvvatlashi kerak. Xulosa qilib aytganda, o'qish usuli o'zgargan bo'lsa-da, kitoblar ta'limda muhim, ikkalasini ham qadrlashimiz kerak.

t11.title: Letter about cancelled lessons
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who also attends the swimming lessons. Write about your feelings and what you think the sports center should do during this period.
t11.sample: Hi Sam, I just got the email — they've cancelled our swimming lessons for the whole month and I'm really annoyed! I was finally getting the hang of it. I reckon the centre should at least offer us free gym sessions or a refund while the pool is closed. Fancy going for a run together instead? Let me know! Take care, Alex
t11.sampleA1: Hi Sam, No swimming lessons this month. I am sad. I like swimming. The centre must help us. We can run together. Please write to me. Alex
t11.sampleA2: Hi Sam, The swimming lessons are cancelled for one month. I am not happy about this. I like swimming a lot. I think the centre should give us free gym or a refund. Do you want to run with me? Please write to me. Alex
t11.sampleB1: Hi Sam, I got an email today. The swimming lessons are cancelled for a month. I feel a bit sad because I really enjoy them. I think the sports centre should give us free gym sessions or money back. Do you want to do another sport together while we wait? Write back soon. Alex
t11.sampleB2: Hi Sam, Did you get the email? They've cancelled our swimming lessons for three weeks because of pool repairs — such a pain! I was really starting to get into it. I reckon the centre should throw in free gym passes to make up for it. Fancy going for a jog together in the meantime? Let me know! Take care, Dilnoza
t11.uzSample: Salom Sam, hozirgina xat oldim — suzish darslarimizni butun oyga bekor qilishibdi va men juda xafaman! Endi o'rganib borayotgan edim. Menimcha, hovuz yopiq turganda markaz bizga hech bo'lmasa bepul sport zali yoki pulni qaytarishni taklif qilishi kerak. Birga yugurishga chiqamizmi? Xabar ber! O'zingni ehtiyot qil, Alex
t11.uzSampleA1: Salom Sam, bu oy suzish darslari yo'q. Men xafaman. Suzishni yaxshi ko'raman. Markaz bizga yordam berishi kerak. Birga yugursak bo'ladi. Iltimos, menga yoz. Alex
t11.uzSampleA2: Salom Sam, suzish darslari bir oyga bekor. Men buni yoqtirmayapman. Suzishni juda yaxshi ko'raman. Menimcha, markaz bepul sport zali yoki pulni qaytarishi kerak. Men bilan yugurasanmi? Iltimos, menga yoz. Alex
t11.uzSampleB1: Salom Sam, bugun xat keldi. Suzish darslari bir oyga bekor. Men biroz xafaman, chunki ularni yaxshi ko'raman. Menimcha, markaz bizga bepul sport zali yoki pulni qaytarishi kerak. Kutgan vaqtimizda birga boshqa sport bilan shug'ullanamizmi? Tez javob yoz. Alex
t11.uzSampleB2: Salom Sam, xatni ko'rdingmi? Suzish darslarini bir oyga bekor qilishibdi va men juda xafaman. Menimcha, markaz evaziga bir narsa berishi kerak — bepul sport zali yoki pulning bir qismini qaytarishi. Balki shu vaqt ichida birga boshqa joyda shug'ullanarmiz? Fikringni bildir. Alex

t12.title: Feedback for the program manager
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the swimming program manager. Explain your opinion about the cancelled lessons and suggest some improvements or alternative activities.
t12.sample: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing regarding the recent cancellation of the swimming lessons at your centre. While I understand that maintenance is sometimes unavoidable, I was very disappointed to learn that the programme will be suspended for an entire month with no clear alternative offered. Many members, myself included, rely on these sessions for exercise and routine. I would therefore like to suggest a few improvements. Firstly, the centre could provide free access to the gym or fitness classes during the closure. Secondly, offering a partial refund or extending memberships by one month would be a fair gesture. Finally, clearer communication in advance would help members plan. I hope you will consider these suggestions. Yours faithfully, Alex Carter
t12.sampleA1: Dear Sir or Madam, The swimming lessons are cancelled. One month is too long. I want to swim. Please give us free gym. Or give money back. Please tell us early next time. Thank you. Yours faithfully, Alex Carter
t12.sampleA2: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing about the swimming lessons. They are cancelled for one month. This is a problem for me because I like to swim every week. I think you should give us free gym in this month. You can also give some money back. Please tell members earlier next time. Thank you. Yours faithfully, Alex Carter
t12.sampleB1: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing about the swimming lessons that are cancelled. I understand that you need to do maintenance, but one month is a long time and there is no other activity for us. Many members like me use these lessons to keep fit. I think you should give us free gym access during this time. You could also give some money back or add one month to our memberships. Please tell us earlier next time. Yours faithfully, Alex Carter
t12.sampleB2: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing in response to your email regarding the temporary cancellation of the swimming lessons for maintenance work. While I appreciate that repairs are sometimes unavoidable, I must admit I was rather disappointed, as many of us rely on these sessions to stay active and stick to a routine. I would like to put forward a few suggestions. Firstly, it would be greatly appreciated if members could be granted free access to the gym or fitness classes during the closure. Secondly, extending our memberships by three weeks, or offering a partial refund, would be a fair way to make amends. Finally, giving us more notice in advance would help everyone plan ahead. I hope you will take these ideas on board. Thank you for inviting our feedback. Yours faithfully, Bekzod Aliyev
t12.uzSample: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, markazingizdagi suzish darslarining yaqinda bekor qilingani yuzasidan yozmoqdaman. Ta'mirlash ba'zan zarur ekanini tushunsam-da, dasturning butun bir oyga to'xtatilishi va aniq muqobil taklif qilinmagani meni juda xafa qildi. Ko'p a'zolar, jumladan men ham, bu mashg'ulotlarga tayanamiz. Shu sababli bir nechta taklif bermoqchiman. Birinchidan, yopiq davrda sport zali yoki fitnes darslariga bepul ruxsat berish mumkin. Ikkinchidan, pulning bir qismini qaytarish yoki a'zolikni bir oyga uzaytirish adolatli bo'lardi. Nihoyat, oldindan aniq xabar berish a'zolarga rejalashtirishga yordam beradi. Ushbu takliflarni ko'rib chiqasiz degan umiddaman. Hurmat bilan, Alex Carter
t12.uzSampleA1: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, suzish darslari bekor. Bir oy juda uzoq. Men suzmoqchiman. Iltimos, bepul sport zali bering. Yoki pulni qaytaring. Keyingi safar erta ayting. Rahmat. Hurmat bilan, Alex Carter
t12.uzSampleA2: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, suzish darslari haqida yozmoqdaman. Ular bir oyga bekor. Bu men uchun muammo, chunki har hafta suzishni yaxshi ko'raman. Menimcha, shu oyda bizga bepul sport zali berishingiz kerak. Pulni ham biroz qaytarishingiz mumkin. Keyingi safar oldinroq ayting. Rahmat. Hurmat bilan, Alex Carter
t12.uzSampleB1: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, bekor qilingan suzish darslari haqida yozmoqdaman. Ta'mirlash kerakligini tushunaman, lekin bir oy uzoq vaqt va biz uchun boshqa mashg'ulot yo'q. Men kabi ko'p a'zolar bu darslar bilan sog'lom bo'ladi. Menimcha, shu vaqtda bizga bepul sport zali berishingiz kerak. Pulni qaytarish yoki a'zolikka bir oy qo'shish ham mumkin. Keyingi safar oldinroq ayting. Hurmat bilan, Alex Carter
t12.uzSampleB2: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, markazingizdagi suzish darslarining bekor qilingani haqida yozmoqdaman. Ta'mirlash zarur bo'lishi mumkinligini tushunaman, lekin dasturning bir oyga muqobilsiz to'xtatilishi meni xafa qildi. Ko'p a'zolar bu darslarga bog'liq. Ushbu fikrlarni ko'rib chiqasiz degan umiddaman. Hurmat bilan, Alex Carter

tasks.p1_context: You are a member of a sports center. You received an email from the swimming program manager.
tasks.p1_scenario:
Dear Member,

We would like to inform you that our swimming lessons will be temporarily cancelled for the next three weeks due to maintenance work at the swimming pool.

We understand that many members may be disappointed by this situation, so we would like to hear your opinion. How do you feel about the cancellation of the lessons? What alternative activities do you think we should organize during this period? Are there any improvements you would like us to make before the swimming classes begin again?

We appreciate your feedback and suggestions.

Kind regards,

The Program Manager
